# Data-Related Requests from Other IOTC Meetings

The IOTC Working Parties (WPs) and the Scientific Committee (SC) identify data requirements relevant to stock assessments, fisheries monitoring and reporting. Addressing these requests may involve direct exchanges with CPCs, targeted reviews of existing datasets, and the development of reporting or validation procedures.

A total of 24 data-related requests arising from the 28^th^ session of the SC and other IOTC meetings have been referred to the WPDCS for consideration. These requests are compiled in **[Appendix IV](#requests)** for review by the WPDCS, including the identification of appropriate follow-up actions and recommendations.
